'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]] 
***[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
****[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] have captured more than 100 [[Russia]]n soldiers in the last 24 hours during their offensive in [[Kursk Oblast]]. Zelenskyy also says that he is open to [[Prisoner exchange|exchanging]] the prisoners for [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[prisoners of war]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj627x96gxxo (BBC News)]
****Ukraine announces that it will create a strategic [[buffer zone]] on the [[Russia–Ukraine border]] that is "designed to protect our border communities from daily enemy attacks". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-keeps-pounding-kursk-incursion-biden-calls-real-dilemma-putin-2024-08-14/ (Reuters)]
****[[Russia]] evacuates thousands more civilians from borderlands in the [[Kursk Oblast]] amid deeper progression of the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine]] into the region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-evacuate-thousands-more-kursk-region-attacked-by-ukraine-2024-08-15/ (Reuters)]
***Ukrainian [[drone warfare|drones strike]] the [[Borisoglebsk air base]] in [[Voronezh Oblast]], Russia, destroying several [[hangar]]s. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/08/14/7470401/ (Pravda)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/08/14/ukraine-russia-kursk-incursion-airfields-belgorod/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Three-phase Israel–Hamas war ceasefire proposal]]
***Top [[Hamas]] official [[Osama Hamdan]] states that the organization is "losing faith" in the [[United States]]' role as mediator in [[Israel]]–Hamas [[Ceasefire|ceasefire]] proposals due to the U.S. not applying pressure on Israel to act in good faith, and threatens to withdraw from future U.S.-mediated negotiations. [https://apnews.com/article/hamas-israel-gaza-ceasefire-negotiations-us-8509c5e68d57c96af99653c8292180b2 (AP)]
*[[Libyan crisis (2011–present)]]
**[[Libya]]'s [[House of Representatives (Libya)|House of Representatives]] vote to end the term of the [[Government of National Accord|Tripoli-based government]] led by [[Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh]], declaring the eastern-based cabinet as the legitimate government. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/libyan-parliament-ends-term-of-tripoli-based-government-amid-political-rift/3302812 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season#Hurricane Ernesto|Tropical Storm Ernesto]] strengthens into a [[hurricane]] north of [[Puerto Rico]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna166511 (NBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[African mpox epidemic]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] officially declares a new outbreak of [[mpox]]. The strain of this outbreak is different from the primary strain of the [[2022–2023 mpox outbreak]], which affected thirteen countries and resulted in at least 524 reported deaths, and the new strain is more lethal. [https://apnews.com/article/who-mpox-africa-health-emergency-cc9bdf31b49d06bec5efd44fb55d5e42 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Nord Stream pipeline sabotage]]
**[[Germany]] issues its first [[arrest warrant]] related to the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline sabotage for a [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] man who crossed the border from [[Poland]] into [[Ukraine]] before the arrest could be carried out. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-nord-stream-pipelines-explosions-investigation-d5579ea69995e8f309ac58c588c39004 (AP)]
*[[Illegal drug trade in the United States]]
**The [[United States]] [[Drug Enforcement Administration]] announces that it seized more than {{conv|2300|lb|kg|abbr=on}} of [[methamphetamine]]s hidden in [[celery]] at a [[farmers market]] in [[Forest Park, Georgia|Forest Park]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], United States. A [[Mexico|Mexican]] citizen was arrested in relation to the seizure. [https://apnews.com/article/methamphetamine-hidden-celery-georgia-farmers-market-c95ba4ee54ff4e93f10a720e2069ee21 (AP)]
*[[Organized crime in Sweden]]
**[[Sweden]], [[Denmark]], [[Norway]], and [[Finland]] form an international police hub in [[Stockholm]] to prevent escalating Swedish [[Gang|gang activity]] and criminal networks from spreading to other [[Nordic countries]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/nordic-countries-join-forces-combat-spread-swedish-gang-crime-2024-08-14/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Constitutional Court of Thailand]] dismisses [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] [[Srettha Thavisin]] for illegally appointing a minister to his cabinet. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/judgment-day-thai-pm-srettha-court-rules-dismissal-case-2024-08-13/ (Reuters)]
*Former [[President of Argentina]] [[Alberto Fernández]] is indicted on charges of making threats and causing bodily harm to former first lady [[Fabiola Yáñez]]. [https://buenosairesherald.com/politics/alberto-fernandez-formally-indicted-for-making-violent-threats-causing-bodily-harm (''Buenos Aires Herald'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/08/14/argentina-alberto-fernandez-abuse-investigation/41b11046-5a8e-11ef-93a9-023ab69f91f5_story.html (Washington Post)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2024 Kiribati parliamentary election]]
**[[Kiribati]] citizens vote for the 45 members of the [[House of Assembly (Kiribati)|parliament]]. [https://apnews.com/article/kiribati-election-china-australia-pacific-00723cfb7e0b8d5e3f21bfc330f1caaa (AP)]
*[[2024 Liberal Democratic Party (Japan) presidential election]]
**[[Japan]]'s [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] and president of the ruling [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|Liberal Democratic Party]] [[Fumio Kishida]] announces that he will not run in the party’s presidential election scheduled for late September, effectively stepping down from the premiership. [https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/politics/politics-government/20240814-204970/ (The Japan News)]
*After more than a year of high-level investigation, [[Vatican City|the Vatican]] expels [[Luis Fernando Figari]], the leader of the [[Peru]]vian [[society of apostolic life]] [[Sodalitium Christianae Vitae]], for financial [[Corruption#Religious organizations|corruption]] and for downplaying allegations of [[sexual abuse|sexual]] and [[psychological abuse]]. [https://apnews.com/article/vatican-sodalitium-peru-abuse-figari-04642fa1e9a3c00213430c07a5747cce (AP)]
